items.title: Dave Valentin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: Bill O’Connell, Robby Ameen, Lincoln Goines and Milton Cardona. I believe in family affair. They’ve been with me for more than fifteen years.

ctx.x: Have you had any disasters on the road? I mean doing traveling around the world?

I think, no, not really. I think one of the worst times I had was breaking somebody’s passing away to one of the band members. I think that was difficult for me. I had to tell Bill O’Connell that a fax came under my door that his father had passed away. And then I had to go and tell him. And I just broke down. Because my father had passed away so it just brought back — so I’m out of it. And Bill O’Connell says, “Dave it’s okay, are you © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
all right?” He was comforting me, because I guess he was expecting it but I wasn’t. But I think that’s something that stands out in my mind.
